QuestInfo.name: [Masteria] Welcome to NLC!
QuestInfo.0: You meet Icebyrd Slimm, the mayor of NLC. Though most of what he says seems hard to believe, one thing is certain: Masteria is a very strange place. Go forth, and learn more about this land!
